limitations: Synthetic pilot with populated Overview wallet graph and one manual goal; no credentials or external provider traffic.
Fresh backend/browser per ABBA entry; cold module cache. Route order is reversed in pair two to expose shared-chunk first-use cost.
Headless Linux and loopback transport; elapsed and CDP renderer-task observations are bounded comparative samples, not desktop/GPU or internet speed claims.

Settled ready time includes two animation frames plus 200ms minimum settle guard and 80ms quiet request confirmation; visibleReadyMs is also retained. No initial route reads may spill into the next sample.

Dedicated Atlas worker script completion transfers away from parent CDP Network; its observed target detachment closes that request and is required for settled completion. Renderer task metrics exclude worker-thread CPU.
Gzip bytes are compressed asset potential, not actual HTTP content-encoding; this server can deliver raw JavaScript.
Loading/failure/retry, mounted-draft and detached-surface diagnostics run after every timed observation.
